Keep toilet tissue within reach and add a convenient spot for small essentials with one wall-mounted piece in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. This Waverly Place Collection toilet paper holder pairs a two-post tissue holder with an integrated glass shelf for everyday bathroom organization.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built to last: solid brass construction for enduring performance
- Coordinate your bath: part of the Waverly Place collection of transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware, designed for matching Waverly Place looks
- Finish flexibility: multiple designer finish options available

Specs & Installation:
- Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 8.75 x 4.6 x 6 inches (6-inch projection)
- Mounting: wall mount; installation hardware included; assembly required: no
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
